facts.fact: The Cour des comptes' 2018 review of 22 communes (2014-2018) found most had no exhaustive, updated census of their taxable base for communally managed levies (signs, tourist premises, function halls), and treasuries kept no dedicated registers of receivables; the report is dated 2020-12-01 and the audit period is used for as_of.

systems.tiers: tax rolls drawn up centrally, sent to communal treasurers who notify and collect

note: Property tax and waste levy rolls are set by the tax administration and collected by the state's communal treasurers (central); the report states treasuries lack IT equipment and software, and gives no commune-run electronic revenue system, count or share.
